scheme_name: Pension Scheme to Old Age Persons (Senior Citizen)
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
Applicant must not be receiving financial assistance under any other old age pension scheme
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 for seniors aged 60–69 and ₹2,000 for those aged 70 and above, transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account via DBT.
